set.body: CanvasViewerController.close() only sets active=false; it does not release CanvasViewerRuntime.viewerCache / rasterCache or CanvasImageSource/ImageBitmap handles (modules/image-view-canvas/js/.../CanvasViewerHost.scala). Add dispose(): close + clear both caches + close ImageBitmaps; idempotent. Consumer: neuropublish viewer-laminar VolumeHost (Stage 0 lifecycle spike). Acceptance: a JS test asserts caches are empty and bitmaps closed after dispose; second dispose is a no-op.
set.title: Add CanvasViewerController.dispose() that releases caches and ImageBitmaps
